Our technical approach is built to deliver the rehabilitation, widening and improvement of 64 km of district roads and reconstruction of three RCC bridges within the 24‑month period, explicitly planning around two monsoon seasons using a CPM-based baseline program and rolling 4‑week lookaheads. We will submit the bid under the single stage one envelope procedure as per KPPRA Rules 2014 and will provide bid security of PKR 37 million via CDR/bank guarantee; we have an established bank guarantee facility of PKR 100 million to support this requirement. [CO-PROFILE]

Methodology (end-to-end): (1) Mobilization and surveys: joint corridor reconnaissance, utility/encroachment mapping, traffic count confirmations, and setting out. (2) Earthworks and formation: scarification, strengthening and widening in controlled layers with compaction control and drainage-first sequencing to protect works during rains. (3) Pavement: staged granular layers and asphalt surfacing in traffic-manageable lengths; interface controls at tie-ins and urban stretches. (4) Structures: bridge reconstruction sequenced to maintain access where feasible; temporary works design, controlled concrete production/placement, and staged launching/erection planning supported by our bridge engineering delivery experience on multiple assignments. [CAP-040][CAP-004][CAP-028] (5) Roadside works and safety: retaining structures, roadside drainage, furniture and line marking delivered as progressive “complete-to-open” sections.

Quality and HSE: We operate under ISO 9001 and maintain a documented HSE policy with a zero reportable fatality record, implementing site safety plans and daily toolbox talks on infrastructure deployments. [CO-PROFILE]

Where evidence is not yet present in our library—(i) PEC constructor registration C‑A/C‑1, (ii) ISO 14001, (iii) verified ownership/access to asphalt/batching/crusher within 50 km, (iv) a prime-contractor bridge span ≥60 m, and (v) nominated key staff meeting the RFP’s years-of-experience thresholds—we will address these through compliant partnering/subcontracting/leased plant arrangements and targeted hiring/nominations prior to award, with documentary proof submitted to C&W for approval. [CO-PROFILE]
